ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCY AGREEMENT

Property: Flat 3, 14 Wharf Street, Leeds LS2 7EQ
Landlord: Corran Lettings Ltd
Tenants: Priya Nair and Tom Ellery
Term: 12 months from 1 September 2026
Rent: £925 per calendar month, due on the 1st of each month

1. Deposit
1.1 The tenants pay a deposit of £1,067, held in the Deposit Protection Service.

2. Ending the tenancy
2.1 After the first six months, the tenants may end this agreement by giving the landlord at least two months' notice in writing.
2.2 Notice must end on the last day of a rental period.

3. Repairs
3.1 The landlord is responsible for the structure and exterior of the flat, and for keeping the installations for water, gas, electricity, heating and hot water, including the boiler, in repair and working order.
3.2 The tenants must report any fault to the landlord within 48 hours of noticing it.
3.3 The tenants pay for damage caused by them or their guests, and for replacing light bulbs and smoke alarm batteries.

4. Pets
4.1 The tenants must not keep any pet at the property without the landlord's prior written permission, which will not be unreasonably refused.
4.2 Where permission is given for a cat or dog, the tenants must have the carpets professionally cleaned at the end of the tenancy.

5. Use of the property
5.1 The tenants must not smoke inside the property.
5.2 The tenants must not sublet the property or any part of it.
